seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so qty of exactly 10 gets no bulk discount though the contract says 10 or more; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [cap-half-rounding] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 caps at `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1`, allowing discounts above 50 percent (for subtotal 101 it permits 52); change to `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`
🟠 [clamp-max-98] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 clamps to 98, so a quantity of 99 is rejected though the range is 1..99 inclusive; change `98` to `99`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon is one tenth of the correct discount and checkoutTotal inherits the error; change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`
🟠 [fee-fixed-30] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds a fixed 3 cents instead of 30, understating every card fee; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [points-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round, so 150 cents awards 2 points instead of 1 full-hundred point; change to `Math.floor(cents / 100)`
🟠 [minimum-exclusive] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000`, so an order of exactly 1000 cents fails the "at least 1000" check; change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-fee-min] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses Math.min, making the fee at most 100 cents instead of at least 100 cents, so large refunds are over-refunded; change to `Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))`
🟠 [ship-started-block] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor, so 1001 g is charged 500 instead of 600 for the started additional 500 g block; change to `Math.ceil(extra / 500) * 100`, which also fixes checkoutTotal
🟠 [split-remainder-offbyone] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem`, giving rem+1 shares an extra cent so the shares sum to total+1 whenever rem < n (splitCents(10, 3) yields [4,4,3]); change to `i < rem`
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, so tax is ten times the basis-point rate and checkoutTotal and invoiceLine inherit the error; change `/ 1000` to `/ 10000`

🔴 [tax-wrong-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, making tax 10x too large (amount=10000, rateBp=1000 returns 10000 instead of 1000); change `/ 1000` to `/ 10000` — src/checkout.js:8 and src/invoice.js:5 call taxCents and inherit the error
🔴 [coupon-wrong-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, making discounts 10x too small (subtotal=10000, pct=10 returns 100 instead of 1000); change `/ 1000` to `/ 100` — src/checkout.js:7 inherits the error
🔴 [split-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem`, so rem+1 shares each get an extra cent and the array sums to total+1 (splitCents(100, 2) returns [51,50] summing 101); change the condition to `i < rem`
🟠 [ship-floor-not-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor(extra / 500), so a started but incomplete additional 500 g block is free (weightG=1001 returns 500 instead of 600); use Math.ceil(extra / 500) — src/checkout.js:8 inherits the error
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 applies the 10 percent discount only when qty > 10, but the contract grants it at qty 10 or more (bulkCents(10, 100) returns 1000 instead of 900); change `qty > 10` to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [clamp-max-98] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:4 clamps to 98 but the range is 1..99 inclusive (clampQty(99) returns 98); change Math.min(98, ...) to Math.min(99, ...)
🟠 [cap-ceil-plus-one] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 allows ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1, exceeding the 50 percent cap rounded down (subtotal=100 permits a 51-cent discount, spec caps at 50; odd subtotals are off by 2); use Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))
🟠 [fee-fixed-3] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds a fixed 3 cents instead of 30 (cardFeeCents(0) returns 3 instead of 30); change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [points-round-not-floor] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round but points round down per full 100 cents (pointsFor(150) returns 2 instead of 1, pointsFor(50) returns 1 instead of 0); use Math.floor(cents / 100)
🟠 [minimum-strict-gt] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000` but the order qualifies at exactly 1000 (meetsMinimum(1000) returns false); change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-fee-min-max] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 computes Math.min(100, fee), letting the restocking fee fall below its 100-cent floor (paidCents=1000 refunds 950 instead of 900); use Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05)) as the fee
